note: Upper Valley counties for the 'This week's birds' list. bbox is [south, west, north, east] in degrees, drawn by hand around each county's town lines. Boxes overlap along the Connecticut River, so a point inside two boxes goes to the county whose box center is nearer (js/brief.js regionFor, DB.regionFor). The same boxes are copied into js/brief.js REGIONS; tests/expected.test.mjs fails if the two drift.
